consequence.statement: Values set under endpointStatus (endpointStatus.enabled, endpointStatus.status) will no longer take effect; operators must migrate to monitoring endpoints via Cilium metrics (cilium_policy, cilium_policy_endpoint_enforcement_status, cilium_controllers_failing, cilium_endpoint_state) or the cilium-dbg endpoint get command.
consequence.remediation: Remove endpointStatus keys from Helm values and switch to metric-based endpoint status monitoring as documented in the upgrade guide.

assertion.statement: The Helm values option endpointStatus has been removed from the Cilium Helm chart; existing configurations using endpointStatus.enabled or endpointStatus.status will no longer be honored.
